hook.name: HeisenbergHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/$HEIST token pool that charges a 2% swap fee split 50/40/10 between a redemption treasury, a platform wallet, and a buy-and-burn fund. Operates 300-block "heist" windows where buyers earn $LOOT rewards based on buy volume and entry timing, with a probabilistic bust mechanic driven by a global heat accumulator and a swap coherence metric.
